display_name: Salus (Runtime Guardrails for AI Agent Actions)
api_paths: (public API contract not disclosed on landing as of 2026-06-07; product is policy-aware proxy in front of every tool the agent already calls; integration documented as 'one endpoint change')
install_tell: Hosted SaaS at usesalus.ai. Apex resolution corrected by Lane C platoon 2026-06-07: salus-ai.com is the Italian medication-management product 'Salus AI Designed for Life' (refuted by Lane B), trysalus.ai is a registered-but-Cloudflare-blocked variant (DMARC ruf=ceo@trysalus.ai), and usesalus.ai is the actual YC W2026 vendor landing (per ycombinator.com/companies/salus). Tagline: 'A runtime for agents that act. Salus sits between AI agents and backend tools, deciding whether each action can execute.'
misconfig_patterns: Architectural pattern is 'policy-aware proxy in front of every tool your agent already calls: change the URL, the agent does not know the difference.' This is identical to the LiteLLM / OpenRouter / agentgateway model: customer ends up sending tool-call payloads (and any embedded customer data) to Salus first. Trust boundary moves to Salus's runtime. No public details on multi-tenancy isolation or per-customer audit-log scoping as of 2026-06-07.

Stated supported agent stacks include 'OpenAI, Anthropic, LangChain, custom, plus voice stacks like Retell and Vapi': voice-agent tool-calls would route through Salus as well, expanding the data the runtime sees to voice-transcript-derived action arguments.

active_probe.false_positive_check: Body must contain BOTH '<title>Salus. A runtime for AI agents' AND the newspaper-style 'Vol. XXI · No. 255' header. The brand 'Salus' is extremely generic (Salus = Roman goddess of safety; used by ~50+ healthcare and wellness products); the newspaper-style typography + the 'identity.ambiguous_caller' policy-tag string are the anchor.

lane_c_specific_finding.verdict: LANE C ABSENT: Salus is a tool-call-proxy at the API layer, not a Google Workspace / Microsoft 365 addon. There is no Workspace Marketplace listing, no AppSource listing, no Graph API or Gmail API OAuth scope manifest exposed (the integration model is 'change the URL the agent calls,' not 'install our addon in your Workspace tenant').
lane_c_specific_finding.verified_by_what: Landing-page text 'policy-aware proxy in front of every tool your agent already calls. Keep your stack. Change the URL. The agent does not know the difference.' This is unambiguous Lane B (API gateway) architecture, not Lane C (Workspace addon).
lane_c_specific_finding.for_lane_b_platoon: Salus belongs to Lane B's tome JSON. This file exists as a stub for Lane C dedup tracking and the apex-resolution-correction record. Lane B should write the full Salus platform JSON.
lane_c_specific_finding.salus_lane_c_email_surface_if_built: If Salus shipped a Workspace addon variant, the scope set would resemble Clawvisor's: Gmail.Send + Gmail.Modify + Calendars.ReadWrite + Files.ReadWrite, because the use-case overlap (validate-then-execute outbound LLM action) is the same. Not built as of 2026-06-07.
